India recorded real GDP growth of 7.8% in the first quarter of FY26-27 compared with 6.9% in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.
weaknesses: Our cost-to-income ratio has demonstrated a consistent declining trend, improving to 50.45% in Q2 from 51.20% in Q2 of last year, reflecting our continued focus on operational efficiency and cost optimization.

opportunities: Our pipeline credit is to the tune of INR 1.58 lakh crores, which provides a strong visibility for future credit growth.
